paragraphs.text: "Chivalry requires a knight to look after his comrades-in-arms. I will not abandon you!"
"Now is the time to choose! Now is the time to shape your stories! Your fate is in your hands!" —Auron
A lean and limber predator whose whiskers acquire charge from naturally-occurring electric particles in the atmosphere.
Within the light, the will of the crystal surged through them. They decided to accept their destiny. And so began a journey to dispel the darkness and return light to the world ...
"A new letter has arrived just for you, kupo!"
"'Lali-ho' is the dwarven greeting!"
"You would have me destroy the Empire? Is this my duty? Is this what you want?" —Ashelia B'nargin Dalmasca
"That's the ticket! Now, let's get moving to North Mountain!" —Galuf Baldesion
These cybersoldiers were specifically engineered to excel in combat, and serve as the powerhouse of the imperial infantry.
"I shall remain here and devote myself to the care of the wounded."
"Thanks, moogles! We're in your debt!" —Locke Cole
A feather with the power to revive those who have exhausted their strength.
"I am Noctis, Prince of Lucis and King of Fishing!"
"Seeing how you enjoy fishing, you should learn how to prepare your catch." —Ignis Scientia
The endless struggle that raged over two thousand years had ended, and peace prevailed once more.
"All I can do is go forward. Keep fighting and surviving, until I find the answers I need."
"How about a three-piece combo of Hi-Potion, Ether, and Phoenix Pinion for 444 Gil?"
"Wark? Kupo!"
"Such devastation ... this was not my intention!" —Gaius van Baelsar
"Show me your strength of will!"
"For the sake of all, I beseech thee: deliver us from this fate!"
"Man in your line of work needs weapons, no? Why not try that one on for size?"
"She gave her life that we might defeat the Ascians. Her sacrifice must not be in vain."
"I give unto you the last of my light, and with it, the last hope of a fading world."
"You've always protected us. But you still don't understand that we looked out for you, too!" —Dagger
"Clueless, aren't you? Good thing I'm here." —Lulu
"I heard that to become a dragoon, you had to make a pact with a living wyvern. However, thanks to the dragonslayers, there aren't that many dragons left." —Ceraulian, San d'Oria citizen
"Don't go back on your word. C'mon, go wave to her."
"Sabin...let's settle this with the toss of a coin."
Restores 20 MP.
"Well now, aren't you just brimming with life? I'd love to suck up all that aether like nectar from a flower!"
"I'm going to help you. To give you what you need to protect us all."
"I will be your monster no more."
"Thank you... for everything... Pray take your rest, Grandfather... You deserve it." —Alisaie Leveilleur
"You're gonna wish you hadn't."
Small Beastmen that live alongside humans in the Aht Urhgan Empire. Their ancestors were nomads in the north, and their unique culture and customs can be seen even now.
In her pictures she captures everything: forests, water, light . . . the very essence of the things she paints.
"'Tis unfortunate that many Ishgardians cannot appreciate the practicality of my work." —Stephanivien de Haillenarte
"Pshhh... Shhhilence, shhhorewalker! Try to eshhhcape, and I'll shhhlice gills into your neck!"
"Barret, be careful! Attack while its tail's up, it's gonna counterattack with its laser." —Cloud Strife
The glory of the tourney awaits!
"It's a little tight, but the price was right!"
"Your eyes, they burn with resolve . . . beautiful."
"My dad always wanted me to go out and travel the world. But it also feels like ... like the wind is calling me." —Bartz Klauser
"Crystal of water, may you regain your light." —Aria Benett
"The Wrath of Dark has nearly reached its zenith! No one can stop it! Least of all you!"
"We found the airship! The records were right."
"I suppose this is my fate as a dark knight. Soon, I won't even feel remorse for my actions."
"This is my battle, one I must fight alone to atone for my wrongs."
"Kuja called them black mages, dark spawn of the mist." —The Soulcage
"Fare you well, Bringer of Light."
"Galuf. It's good to see you again . . . Mwa-hahahahaha!"
When prayers turn to promises, not even fate can stand in their way.
"Just hang in there! Someday we'll look back at these hard times and laugh."
"Once, the monsters of Hell poured forth into the world. They entered using a path known as the Jade Passage." —Hilda, Princess of Fynn
"Hey why don't ya try out that sword I gave you!" —Wakka
"Hee-hee... Nothing beats the sweet music of hundreds of voices screaming in unison! Uwee-hee-hee!"
They willfully attain an undead existence to serve their foul mistresses for eternity.
"The Jenova Project resulted in my conception."
"Fate is not to be taken lightly, Cloud."
Cie'th are damned to wander the world unliving and undying, until their corrupted flesh at last can move no more.
"End of the line, punk!"
Legend says it is an Anima, guardian to a sacred blade. Though most sacred amongst its kind, its great power drove it to madness, and in the end, it became a threat to its own creator.
The elder primal Odin has returned to Eorzea.
Fearful monsters that creep ever forward, knives poised with deadly intent.
"I finally worked out how to get the door on the left side open! I hope there's somethin' in there besides rats..." —Kytes, street urchin
"This body is... the punishment that's been given to me..."
"You gonna stand there and pretend you can't hear the planet crying out in pain?"
The other colorations of chocobo tend to be quite violent, giving rise to the saying: "Yellow, best for riding; aught else, best be hiding."
"Warriors of Light...Only you can restore hope to the world, for yours is the light that can balance out the darkness..."
"We live not to forget our past, but to learn from it!"
"Double time."
"This place is dangerous! Be careful!" —Zozo resident
"What can I do for you?"
"I was there... I saw when Kefka used his Light of Judgment to torch the village of Mobliz, far to the east." —Tzen resident
"Perhaps this is a test and you must prove yourself worthy."
"O my hero, my beloved, shall we still be made to part?"
"Look out world, here we come!"
These strange, ambulatory cacti are commonly found in the Altepa Desert of the Kuzotz Region, and little regarding their way of life is known to science.
"Hah! If I'd just left you in the lurch, I'd look like a jerk for all of history!" —Gilgamesh
"Sorry for making you wait, Yuna. I had some promises to keep, ya?"
"The price for your meddling is death beyond death."
A name in blood, a pact of flame.
"I am Ramuh—the esper."
"The time has come to put my training to use!"
"I shall hereby do my best to kidnap you!"
"My weapons are these fists of mine!"
"Just our luck to crash in this forest... it's gonna get interesting..." —Baku, Tantalus leader
"Sometimes it's better to run!" —Quistis Trepe
"Everyone seems to be calling for Wakka, folks!" —Blitzball announcer
A cactus with legs that loves to run hither and thither. Watch out for its thorns!
"No matter how you make your bet, you win some and you lose some. It all comes down to skill and luck." —Racing expert
"Guy speak beaver."
A tutelary creature said only to appear when the planet is in grave danger.
"I've chosen a name for her . . . Terra."
"I'll destroy you Exdeath... even if it means I have to take you into the afterlife myself!"
The gigantoad is known to venture outside of its comfort zone during downpours—much to the surprise of unsuspecting hikers.
The parasitic moss that grows in the folds of the goobbue's back is highly valued as an ingredient in various potions and medicines.
A mysterious beast that has grown large on its journey across Gran Pulse. Its children, known as microchus, accompany the ochu in combat against adventurers.
Some Cactuars live long lives and grow huge. This Jumbo Cactuar is one of them.
"I've come to realize that it's important to put down the book every now and then, and experience some adventures for myself."
"There's only one reason. They smell an adventure! C'mon! We've got no time to lose!"
"Guess this is goodbye, City of Mako." —Tifa Lockhart
"The Seventh Astral Era is come!"
"Ride ze shoopuf? All aboards!"
"Are you okay? You should be able to move now." —Rydia, Summoner of Mist
"Chocobo, we just can't catch a break, can we?"
The chick has no name, as voicing the true identity of the animal might trigger ripples of destiny across Cocoon and cause a hurricane in Eden. Either that, or Sazh just hasn't thought of one yet.
A pleasingly plump summon.
"Thank you, Torgal. For never giving up." —Clive Rosfield
"This is Cornelia, the city of dreams."
"We are the Cloud of Darkness! Bringer of wrath and destroyer of light!"
"Mwa-hahahaha! Witness what befalls those who stand against me!"
"All memories . . . dimensions . . . existence . . . All that is shall be returned to nothing."
"We will fight along with you for the planet, our home!"
"Guard the king with our lives—that's the way it's always been."
"In ashen grip, let ember glow, to kindle flames anew."
"Peace is but a shadow of death, desperate to forget its painful past..."
"Yes, this is it! This is the power I've always wanted!"
"As long as there are people who need to be protected, I'll keep on fighting!"
Many sacrificed all for the King; so must the King sacrifice himself for all.
"Our own private heaven."
L'Cie who fulfill their Focus for their fal'Cie master are transformed into crystal and granted life eternal.
"Every blitzer knows: when you got the ball, you gotta score!"
"Time... it will not wait... no matter... how hard you hold on. It escapes you..."
"The pinnacle o' perfection, forged from blood, sweat, an' tears!" —Gerolt Blackthorne
Fully recovers HP and MP.
The ultimate sword, used by a legendary king. It was forged in another world.
"I must say, I quite enjoy these tussles."
"It's not about finding the single best ingredient. It's about crafting that perfect blend of meat, egg, and shrimp. That harmony of flavors is key."
The iron giant is both hostile and powerful, using a giant blade to fell its foes. The mere mention of its name strikes fear in the hearts of drivers who know how perilous the roads are at night.
"Lions are known for their great strength and pride."
"Inside the Lunatic Pandora is this thing called a Crystal Pillar. It calls monsters from the Moon." —Zell Dincht
"Gimme elixir!"
"Thank you!"
"Let's get the hell out of here!" —Zell Dincht
"Kings of Lucis... come to me!" —Noctis Lucis Caelum
And so their quest began.
"Welcome! We have rooms for 200 gil a night. Would you like to stay and rest your body and mind?" —Innkeep
The advent of the airship marked the realization of Baron's dreams, but also the birth of its militarism.
A city built upon the Isles of Ark that straddle the continents of Storm and Ash.
"You've got to destroy the Dreadnought!" —Bafsk resident
This city, Cocoon's capital, shares its name with its fal'Cie patron.
"They say that beyond the dunes is the Town of Ruin, but no one can even enter the desert to find out, let alone cross it." —Cid Previa
After relaxing at Costa del Sol, stop by the Gold Saucer. It's a rich and exciting place to play!
"The Shinra people told us that everyone would be happy once the reactor was built. But all it brought us was sadness..." —Gongaga villager
"We Guado protect the Farplane so the dead can rest in peace." —Guadosalam citizen
"I need only know that you are ready to leave home behind," said King Regis. "Don't know about you, but I'm ready as I'll ever be," replied Noctis.
A great and proud nation devoted to Halone, the Fury.
A city encircled by the ramparts of a massive castle.
A triumph of technology and testament to man's potential.

The town proper of Rabanastre is divided into four sections by the cardinal directions of the compass. The east and west are merchant districts, the streets lined with shops and stalls of every description.
"The Sharlayans were the keepers of wisdom both old and new. Their mastery over magic and aether was unsurpassed, and even the Garleans knew to fear them." —Minfilia Warde
When darkness veils the world, four Warriors of Light shall come.
"There aren't many nobles living here. The nights are long. It's a great place for thieves." —Marcus, Tantalus thief
"If we allow the Empire to continue expanding its Magitek arsenal... history's greatest mistake will be repeated." —Banon, Leader of the Returners
The first Star Sibyl gained the powers of the stars and moon at Full Moon Fountain. She found the stars of hope from within the darkness, and led Windurst to glory.
A city dead for a thousand years. The end of Yuna's journey.
"You're the spitting image of Maria!" —Jidoor resident
"No matter how bitter the truth that awaits me, I will press on."
"Moment of truth, Hero."
"Life... Dreams... Hope... Where do they come from? And where do they go? Such meaningless things... I'll destroy them all!"
"Let us summon a sea in a new dream world."
"I am Ramuh— the esper."
"Pretty confident. Let's see how you do."
"Hm! Not bad for a human."
"I've chosen a name for her... Terra."
"Who dares summon me from the darkness?"
"I am simply myself. No more and no less. And I want only to be free."
"I have no regrets for becoming a white mage and fighting alongside a brave knight."
"I see... so, you seek to save the world. Then I guess that means I shall save the world as well. Lead on! I will copy your every move."
"Don't you know it's rude to enter without knocking? Hmph, the youth of today..."
"It's not like everyone can get by on their own, you know?"
"As I suspected, the aetheric disturbance here is no natural occurrence."
"If I don't figure out our Focus soon... Vanille's gonna be a Cieʼth. I'll tear down the sky if it'll save her."
"Well, well, trying to follow in my footsteps, are you?"
"Your hope ends here. And your meaningless existence with it."
"The heavens are too small a field for our dance. Let us transcend this mortal coil!"
"I had to be strong for Serah, so I thought I needed to forget my past. And I became Lightning."
"Oh? Are you defying me as well?"
"Come, then! Who will be next to die on my steel!?"
"Call me Bartz. Me and my chocobo just go wherever the trail leads us..."
"World only have two things: Things you can eat and things you no can eat."
"I'm pretty good at taking care of myself, you know."
"These memories generate sssuffering... these thoughtsss... bring remorssse..."
"You fool. Do I look like some lowly black mage soldier?"
"It's not over yet... this isn't the end!"
"What will become of our triumphs? Our hopes? Our... our despair?"
"All the world shall fall by my hand."
"I, Garland, will knock you all down!"
"Even as you die again and again, I shall return!"
"Someday I will be queen, but I will always be myself."
"If we have the power to destroy Cocoon, then we have the power to save it."
"I slew your king. I slew your country. Do these deeds not demand vengeance?"
The end draws near.
"Lightning. It flashes bright, then fades away. It can't protect. It only destroys."
"I'll control the world with fear. It takes too much to do it like my old man."
"Ohohoho! I might be the harshest mistress in all of Vana'diel. But I may yet forgive you, if at my feet you kneel."
"Your vain krusade ends here, SeeDs."
"Time... it will not wait... no matter how hard you hold on. It escapes you..."
"I will stand my ground and be strong."
"Let the flames burn within you! No... let them burn without!"
"This is the end... for all of you."
"I commend your courage, but I will show you no mercy."
"Ultimecia is a fearful sorceress. Her heart is filled with anger and hate." —Edea Kramer
"Come, little lamb... to the slaughter with you!"
"I'm here to even the odds. Any objections?"
"But your struggle was all for naught. Don't you see how close the darkness has drawn?"
"This will be the end of it."
"Traveling the world has taught me how little I know!"
"A new day now begins in Eorzea." —Raubahn Aldynn
"Words aren't the only way to tell someone how you feel."
"Sleep well, and may the shadows keep you."
